top_signal.title: Online shop doing well enough to pay the bills opening a storefront, relatively prime location available now, go for it??
top_signal.summary: Need more space to expand webshops operations, have looked at warehouse space which gives me 0% chance of in-person sales, looking now at a storefront space for the same monthly rent & enough room for both my ops and a shop… thinking I have to go for it!   Any recommendations for how to kick off a good storefront? We are selling sort of niche hobby items, there’s a great local scene for it & hoping to grow it into something people will travel from out of town to visit (event space, community involvement, etc) … wondering if anyone has similar experience?   Most worried about the cost to build out a proper shop layout… we have some grant opportunities that I will be applying for to help… but assuming I need to do this on a strict budget from my own revenue, definitely looking for advice!!       submitted by     /u/kiss_the_siamese_gun       [link]       [comments]
